import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 10, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars2 = ax2.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([f'Kreis {i+1}' for i in range(len(district_counts))], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('District')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars3 = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Gender distribution of dogs
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Dog registrations over time
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=6)
ax5.set_xlabel('Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax5.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax5.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.2)

# 6. Owner age groups
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars6 = ax6.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Owners')
ax6.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Most common dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars7 = ax7.bar(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(color_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Dog Color')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count')
ax7.set_title('Most Common Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Purebred vs mixed distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
purebred_counts = df['Rassetyp1Lang'].value_counts()
colors8 = ['#FFA07A', '#20B2AA', '#778899']
wedges8, texts8, autotexts8 = ax8.pie(purebred_counts.values, labels=purebred_counts.index, 
                                      autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors8)
ax8.set_title('Purebred vs Mixed Breed Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts8:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 9. Dogs per owner (AnzHunde distribution)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
dog_per_owner = df['AnzHunde'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars9 = ax9.bar(dog_per_owner.index, dog_per_owner.values)
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs per Owner')
ax9.set_ylabel('Count')
ax9.set_title('Dogs per Owner Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(dog_per_owner.values):
    ax9.text(dog_per_owner.index[i], v + 50, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis\nComprehensive Overview of Canine Population', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
